Let A, B, C, D be randomly selected subsets of $X=\{1,2,3,\ldots,n\}$ such that $A\cap C=\phi$, $B\cap D=\phi$. The probability of $A\cap B\ne\phi$, $B\cap C\ne\phi$, $C\cap D\ne\phi$ and $D\cap A\ne\phi$, is
\begin{qoptions}
\opt{A}{$(9^n-8^n+7^n-6^n+5^n)/\,9^n$}
\opt{B}{$(9^n-4.8^n+6.7^n-4.6^n+5^n)/\,9^n$}
\opt{C}{$(7^n-2.\,6^n+5^n)/\,7^n$}
\opt{D}{None of these}
\end{qoptions}
\end{bankq}

An insurance company believes that people can be divided into two classes: those who are accident prone and those who are not. The company's statistics show that an accident-prone person will have an accident at some time within a fixed 1-year period with probability 0.4, whereas this probability decreases to 0.2 for a person who is not accident prone. If we assume that 30 percent of the population is accident prone, then the probability that a new policyholder will have an accident within a year of purchasing a policy is $\dfrac{p}{q}$, $p$ and $q$ are co-prime numbers then
\begin{qoptions}
\opt{A}{$p+q=63$}
\opt{B}{$p+q=126$}
\opt{C}{$q-p=37$}
\opt{D}{$q-p=74$}
\end{qoptions}
\end{bankq}

\begin{bankq}[id=SI09-P1-MATH-S1-Q03, source={Score-I - Test 09 (16 Feb 2022)}, paper=1, qno=3, type=single, subtopic={Conditional probability}, answer={A}, answer_src=key, difficulty=4, diff_parts={K2 S1 I1 C1 F0}, diff_note={concepts: standard problem in this chapter, conditional probability | steps: apply the relevant results; compute}]
Consider three sets $E_1=\{1,2,3\}$, $F_1=\{1,3,4\}$ and $G_1=\{2,3,4,5\}$. Two elements are chosen at random, without replacement, from the set $E_1$, and let $S_1$ denote the set of these chosen elements.\\
Let $E_2=E_1-S_1$ and $F_2=F_1\cup S_1$. Now two elements are chosen at random, without replacement, from the set $F_2$ and let $S_2$ denote the set of these chosen elements.\\
Let $G_2=G_1\cup S_2$. Finally, two elements are chosen at random, without replacement, from the set $G_2$ and let $S_3$ denote the set of these chosen elements.\\
Let $E_3=E_2\cup S_3$. Given that $E_1=E_3$, let $p$ be the conditional probability of the event $S_1=\{1,2\}$. Then the value of $p$ is
\begin{qoptions}
\opt{A}{$\dfrac15$}
\opt{B}{$\dfrac35$}
\opt{C}{$\dfrac12$}
\opt{D}{$\dfrac25$}
\end{qoptions}
\end{bankq}

\begin{qoptions}
\opt{A}{$P(E\cap F\cap G^C)\le\dfrac1{40}$}
\opt{B}{$P(E^C\cap F\cap G)\le\dfrac1{15}$}
\opt{C}{$P(E\cup F\cup G)\le\dfrac{13}{24}$}
\opt{D}{$P(E^C\cap F^C\cap G^C)\le\dfrac5{12}$}
\end{qoptions}
\end{bankq}
